commands.command: Run an objective-only sanity update from M132 s60 using the M136 M133 proof-surface retention corpus before any PPO continuation.
commands.name: m137_m133_retention_objective_sanity

decision_rule: Admit a candidate only if it improves the M136 retention objective without regressing M133 behavior or strict proof-surface diversity.
failure_criteria: M136 fixed loss improves but strict proof-surface diversity stays below M133
candidate proceeds to PPO without a formal repeat gate
hypothesis: A fixed objective update on the exact M133 proof-surface retention corpus may preserve the strict rows that M134/M135 PPO shrank better than generic M128 outcome snippets.
success_criteria: M136 retention loss improves on held-out batches
M128 outcome loss is not materially worse than M132 s60
behavior success remains at M132 level
strict selected physical pairs and selected seeds meet or exceed M133 on both miner seeds
